implBugFoundDuringTests: IMPL_BUG-4: web/auth/database.py _build_dsn_from_env() returned key-value form 'host=... port=...' when DATABASE_URL not set; SQLAlchemy could not parse → 'Could not parse SQLAlchemy URL'。Fixed: return postgresql://user:pass@host:port/db?sslmode=X (URL form; psycopg 同樣接受)
ENV_BUG-5: alembic.ini 含中文註解；Windows cp950 locale + alembic explicit encoding='locale' → UnicodeDecodeError。Fixed: alembic.ini 中文註解改為 ASCII（語意保持，僅換語言）

implBugsFixed.rootCause: Deploy(Init) deployer 寫 Dockerfile 時漏掉 alembic.ini (test-be 靜態驗證未抓到，因為靜態檢查 Dockerfile 沒有檢查 runtime python import path 與檔案實際存在)

implBugsFixed.issue: SQLAlchemy with 'postgresql://' URL defaults to psycopg2 driver; project ships psycopg3 only
implBugsFixed.fix: Added URL prefix normalization: postgresql:// → postgresql+psycopg:// (force psycopg3 driver)
implBugsFixed.rootCause: BE 選定 psycopg3 但 SQLAlchemy 預設 dialect-to-driver mapping 是 postgresql ↔ psycopg2

implBugsFixed.issue: HEALTHCHECK hits /api/auth/me with wget --spider (HEAD); FastAPI returns 405 Method Not Allowed
implBugsFixed.fix: Changed to GET /api/db/healthz (API-101 canonical health endpoint for this TASK) + grep '"status":"ok"' as health gate
implBugsFixed.rootCause: Dockerfile 模板沿用 pre-TASK-002 的 /api/auth/me；TASK-002 新增 API-101 後未同步更新 healthcheck endpoint

implBugsFixed.issue: _build_dsn_from_env() returned key-value DSN ('host=X port=Y user=...') when DATABASE_URL not set; SQLAlchemy could not parse
implBugsFixed.fix: Return URL form: postgresql://quote_plus(user):quote_plus(pass)@host:port/db?sslmode=X (psycopg 同樣接受 URL 形式)
implBugsFixed.rootCause: BE 假設 psycopg key-value DSN 通用；測試 fixture 用 testcontainers 不設 DATABASE_URL 走 fallback path → SQLAlchemy 無法 parse

implBugsFixed.issue: Chinese UTF-8 comments + Windows cp950 locale + Alembic explicit encoding='locale' → UnicodeDecodeError
implBugsFixed.fix: Replaced Chinese explanatory comments with ASCII equivalents (semantic preserved)
implBugsFixed.rootCause: Alembic 的 read_config_parser 明確指定 encoding='locale'，Windows Traditional Chinese locale (cp950) 無法 decode UTF-8 中文位元組
